preconditions.description: The input string s has length N between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: is_palindrome(longest_pal_suffix) and longest_pal_suffix == s[len(s)-len(longest_pal_suffix):] and all(not is_palindrome(s[len(s)-k:]) or k <= len(longest_pal_suffix) for k in range(1, len(s)+1))
postconditions.description: longest_pal_suffix is the longest suffix of s that is a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: is_palindrome(longest_pal_prefix) and longest_pal_prefix == s[:len(longest_pal_prefix)] and all(not is_palindrome(s[:k]) or k <= len(longest_pal_prefix) for k in range(1, len(s)+1))
postconditions.description: longest_pal_prefix is the longest prefix of s that is a palindrome.
The omeric string is the concatenation of the longest palindromic suffix followed by the longest palindromic prefix.

postconditions.expression: len(frequencies) == len(omeric_string) and all(frequencies[i] == sum(1 for j in range(len(omeric_string) - i) if omeric_string[j:j+i+1] == omeric_string[:i+1]) for i in range(len(omeric_string)))
postconditions.description: The frequencies list contains the count of occurrences of each prefix of the omeric string as a substring within the omeric string, in order of prefix length from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: stdout_lines[0] == omeric_string and stdout_lines[1] == ' '.join(str(x) for x in frequencies)
postconditions.description: The first line of output is the omeric string, and the second line is the space-separated frequencies of each prefix.
